name: v2.73.1
body:
## Changelog
### Fixes
* 41a618c046fc5f7bb47cfebcd485d022c9ed5eb8 fix: Don't double backslashes in shellQuote
* c6778d6771766daba702848b5a0f9b31bbbafa82 fix: Pass /dev/null to diff command for missing files in apply --interactive
* 6933f7858b0855f997d8b0c9d5c5218d44ea7911 fix: Fix panic in add when adding file in external_ explicit dir
* 2abb5f7d684166ec7110ca944aa2f0acb32b860e fix: Fix panic in re-add with exact_ dirs with implicit parents
* 3cd47c524444ffa16038f18a7190b781f29ca5e6 fix: Fix panic in re-add with externals with implicit parents
* 56ef8a372e53e5cf5832ed8e867798fd3b7758b9 fix: Report correct line number for secrets found by add
### Documentation
* 7cd56b9caf96cd1606e860532a692ea0dbf10924 docs: State that re-add command does not cover externals
* 544cb5b4ef63080980c411191214e21161e2265d docs: Add link to article
